name: Python Wormhole
r_skills: Python: pandas, scipy.stats, statsmodels, seaborn, pyreadstat
stats_concepts: The same analyses in Python, side by side with R
briefing: Through the wormhole the ship's computer reads the Crew Log in a second language: Python. Same log, same questions, other words. Can you make Python give exactly the numbers R gave?

log.title: Entry 13: Two languages
log.text: Read through Python, the log is unchanged: 1,277 missions, 564 astronaut IDs, a median mission of 261 hours against a mean of 1,051. Every analysis you ran in R came back with the same numbers in pandas and scipy, once their defaults were set to match. The findings belong to the data, not to the software.
